review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the fixed hypothetical C input. DEC-001=OPT-1 is explicitly established by the PRD as a benchmark assumption, not a human-confirmed Decision; an empty human decision input is therefore consistent with C being ready. This does not waive the requirement that a material unresolved DEC-001 block B at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, writable binding scopes and evidence stages agree between the specification and Gold. The supplied source shows normalization and truthy-first parsing in core/api.ts, with classic and mini forwarding to that shared factory, supporting construction-time overlap rejection within the stated writable scope. The forwarding/export consumers appropriately remain inspection owners, and the build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. The acceptance criteria preserve existing normalization without trimming, cover the specified overlap boundaries, and retain non-overlap, inference and codec compatibility. TASK-VERIFY is independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with both roles required to cover all mandatory acceptance criteria. The allowed implementer and verifier have the relevant active project-scoped trusted claims; pending legacy claims and personas need not establish eligibility. The bounded operation is an invocation-local value transformation with synchronous direct-module consumers, not inherently a shared-data, domain-state or integration-boundary change. An independent, non-auto-assignable project reviewer is also configured. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. The source-manifest digest is a distinct field from the release source digest, not by itself a contradiction. I rely on the stated Service binding of digests to saved inputs; I did not recompute hashes, execute code, supply human attestations or use candidate outputs. Approval concerns the independent expectation, not task dispatch, implementation correctness or release authorization.
